description: Header file defining the AckController class, which manages acknowledgment operations, timer timeouts, and completion handlers for power state transitions in a device management system.

classes.name: AckController
classes.description: Manages acknowledgment operations, timers, and completion callbacks for power state transitions, supporting asynchronous acknowledgment handling with timeout rescheduling.

methods.name: AckController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AckController with a specified power state.

methods.name: ~AckController
methods.description: Destructor that revokes ongoing operations if active.

methods.name: powerState
methods.description: Returns the target power state for the current transition.

methods.name: AckAwait
methods.description: Adds a client ID to the set of pending acknowledgments.

methods.name: Ack
methods.description: Removes a client acknowledgment, triggers completion if last acknowledgment received.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment process is active.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the set of pending client IDs.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a timeout and completion handler for acknowledgment collection.

methods.name: Reschedule
methods.description: Updates the timeout for acknowledgment collection.
